page.overview:
Who is Baron?

After defeating , will recover the - a mask that resembles 's face. Whichever Drifter is present will ask to see the mask and relate the history of before purchasing the mask to bury. However, the story that is related will change depending on the . These stories, therefore, may all be fictitious rumors or separate parts of 's story. There are several common threads between the stories, however, including the manufacture of the mask, a war, 's personal loss, his self-enforced exile and the resemblance of the mask to the god of war, named by as Bamo.

According to , there was a master mask-maker whose creations were loved by children many years before. When war broke out, the artisan's son joined the army and never returned. Several months after his son's presumed death, the mask-maker carved a mask of the god of war, which he donned before joining the war himself. Although he never returned to his village, rumors spread of a masked warrior called Baron who cried as he slew his foes.

A legend told by tells of two gods who were close brothers: Bamo, god of war, and Aron, god of love. When humans first appeared, problems soon arose. These humans wanted to steal the land of the gods and attacked when Bamo was abroad, killing Aron. Bamo took revenge wearing a devil's mask, killing many humans in combat. This failed to assuage his pain, and at last Bamo hid in a cave. Eventually the humans forgot their crime and began to search for Bamo, possibly explaining the skulls found upon the chamber's floor. or possibly both gods in one form. This latter possibility may explain 's claim that he never wanted to hurt anyone, while the identification of as a god explains his survival through centuries of hiding.
